issue.title: Bead mutation p95 still grows with stream count: note/update 2.8-2.9x from 1x to 8x, missing the sase-1h8 A1 <10% target
issue.description:
Local bead mutations (`append_note`, `update`) still get slower as the store's stream
count grows, which misses epic sase-1h8's A1 target: p95 moves less than 10% from 1x to
8x.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1h8.14 (perf gate, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2) and recorded
as DISCOVERED ISSUE #6 on epic sase-1h8. Routed here by the sase-1h8 land agent. The
epic's plan routes a missed criterion to a measured follow-up and forbids loosening the
threshold.

Evidence:
- Binding-level, matched corpora (seed 20261006, 20 runs; 1x 6,899 beads/2,000 streams,
  8x 55,516 beads/16,000 streams; host load ~17): p95 at 1x note 114.5 ms, update
  156.5 ms; at 8x note 321.3 ms, update 455.5 ms. The 1x->8x ratio is 2.8x (note) and
  2.9x (update). Artifacts: before file:explicit:c6e84b9abb0aa9ec8460fdf0, after
  file:explicit:cf5bda21694e0423eeb52bd1.
- Perf-gate formal sweep (`sdd/plans/202610/perf_artifacts/bead_perf_gate.json`, core
  pin 5c4033f6, runs=5): ratio:note 1.8x, ratio:update 2.1x. Clean-window medians at 1x
  are about 19 ms. See docs/perf_runbook.md, "Bead history-independence gate".
- strace on one facade append_note at 1x shows 1,383 stat calls in total, including
  interpreter startup, against 2,000 streams. So the path does not do a full
  per-mutation stat sweep, and the original "admission sweep" theory needs revisiting.

Root cause not yet known. Break the 8x cost down into admission/freshness,
MutationView load, event append, publication (write-through), and binding overhead.
Fix the history-scaling term. Then remove `ratio:note` and `ratio:update` from the
`--gate-allow` list in the Justfile's `bead-perf-scale-gate` recipe.

task_type_fields.impact:
Every bead write (notes, updates, closes from agents and the TUI) slows as history
grows. Per-write latency is still about 2-3x worse at 8x history, so the store will
regress again as it keeps growing ~88 beads/day.
task_type_fields.location: sase-core crates/sase_core/src/bead/mutation (runner/view/publish) and read_model freshness; binding append_note/update
